claims.claim: Membrane state makes a temporal motion label decodable on real optical flow as well as synthetic motion.
claims.mechanism: LIF membrane potential v_t = decay*v_{t-1} + syn(spikes_{t-1}) + drive_t carries a decaying trace across frames; stateless propagation is time-permutation-invariant at the readout.
claims.assumptions: Eight-frame clips retain visible motion after 32x32 downsampling and measured ommatidium Voronoi sampling; direction/speed labels are derivable without static leakage; homeostasis keeps synaptic current bounded; five independent seeds.
claims.falsifying_ablation: Remove state (stateless), remove propagation (A=0), or swap to the same-protocol SYNTHETIC domain; the flash task needs no cross-frame integration.
claims.split_protocol: Fixed 70/30 random split identical across conditions, domains and seeds; ridge readout L2=1e-2.
claims.primary_metric: Held-out accuracy on the temporal direction/speed-change label; headline delta = LIF - stateless.
claims.minimum: real-domain delta >= +0.15 with 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
claims.expected_strong: real-domain delta >= +0.25 with CI lower bound > 0 AND a decisive synthetic-versus-real transferability verdict
claims.failure: real-domain ceiling < 0.70, delta <= 0, CI lower bound <= 0, NaN, or missing raw evidence
claims.simple_baseline: Frame-stacked pixel or optical-flow ridge ceiling and the stateless three-step tanh(A@x) GNN.
claims.strong_baseline: Published train-your-fly connectome GNN propagation as the stateless baseline; official static 64.0% is literature context.
claims.matched_control: A=0, degree-preserving rewiring with matched nnz/weights/degree, sign-shuffled E/I, and the same-protocol SYNTHETIC domain.
claims.implementation_path: Local mining/common.py and run_v7_temporal.py; remote experiment.py generated by the novix agent, listing dependencies and writing staged result.json before any early stop.
claims.prototype_check: Local light_smoke.py self-test passed: 7 variants, 19.2 s, 4.0 GB peak, graph load 2.7 s; local round7 measured +0.2817 with CI [0.2033, 0.3617].
claims.calibration_evidence: Local round5..8 measurements calibrate the target. Real optical flow has NOT been measured yet, so these are falsifiable transfer predictions. runtime_hours and memory_gb are planning estimates ONLY; no wall-clock or turn cap is imposed on the novix exp-4090 task and no --timeout/--max-turns is passed.
claims.test_isolation: Held-out split frozen before tuning; all five seeds and every failed run logged; a test used for method selection is never described as unseen.
claims.stop_return_condition: If the real-domain ceiling is below 0.70, a main condition is NaN/unavailable, or the pulled script and result.json are absent, stop before P2 and return to task design; never tune to significance.
